notes.title: Glass Wings has launched!
notes.content:
Thank you for supporting my game! 
Glass Wings is a short proof of concept experience designed to gather feedback and funding for Glass Wings 2.0. As a solo developer, your support and feedback is of great value, and essential to improving present systems for the next iteration of Glass Wings. Thank you for being a part of my journey, and happy running.

notes.title: New Release Date
notes.content:
Although an unconventional move, I've decided to move the release of Glass Wings to September 1st, 2023. In the spirit of transparency, there are a lot of big games coming out in September and again in October, and as a small studio with a small game, I want to give Glass Wings a fighting chance. 

Luckily, Glass Wings is the perfect game to keep you entertained until the likes of Starfield and Mortal Kombat 1 are released!

I look forward to hearing community feedback, happy running!

notes.title: Glass Wings Release Date
notes.content:
I am happy to announce [i]Glass Wings[/i] will officially release the 9th of October! 
The full release will be presented as a proof of concept game, with a handful of unique and challenging levels to play - including a "developer playground" in which the gameplay was initially conceptualized and tested.
In the mean time you can wishlist [i]Glass Wings[/i] to stay up to date on its development and to be notified upon its release.
